verdict.rationale: The speech-to-text API reference documents a multichannel mode in which each channel is transcribed independently. It also offers an optional 'combined' output style for a merged transcript, which directly covers keeping each side of a stereo call separate. Missing for 10: details on supported channel counts and the per-channel output structure, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that per-channel transcription works as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, stereo or multichannel recordings can be transcribed per channel, so each side of a call stays separate

citations.quote: When enabled, each channel is transcribed independently
